items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Farrell was in the band, Eddie Deal played guitar, Garnett Brown played trombone, Floyd Brady, we called him “Trombonski”, he was the oldest guy in the band.

ctx.x: Oh, Virginia Beach, sorry. I thought you said Atlantic City.

And, there were no black people who were going into the beach. Here we are, we’re from New York. There’s a couple of white guys in the band and we decided: okay, lets go to beach tomorrow. So, we go to the beach down by the club that we were working. Let’s see, Joe Farrell was in the band, Eddie Deal played guitar, Garnett Brown played trombone, Floyd Brady, we called him “Trombonski”, he was the oldest guy in the band. So, it was three trombones, two trumpets, me and Martin Banks. So, we all go down to the beach…
It might be in the paper.
